'''Fodu''', or '''Fogu''', was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] served with [[green fire sauce]] in [[Melahnese food|Melahnese cuisine]].

==Behind the scenes==
This food was mentioned with both of the above spellings in [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]. It is unclear which is the primary spelling, however, ''Fodu'' appears first. Alternatively, [[Teela Kaarz|Teela]] may have been bluffing when discussing her cooking ability with [[Villian Dance]] and had no idea what type of food Fodu was, let alone how to cook or pronounce it.
